description: Find grocery products and their current price at every UK supermarket MyGroceryPal tracks, cheapest store first, the same results shoppers see on mygrocerypal.co.uk. Narrow with brands, stores, ownBrandOnly, onOfferOnly and category; sort by unit_price to compare pack sizes, or biggest_saving for deals. Returns 5 products unless limit says otherwise, with totalHits and a nextCursor for the next page. A loyaltyCard price needs that card (Clubcard, Nectar and so on). Each price has a storeUrl that opens that store's product page: give the user these links, not ones you build, when they want to buy. For a list or a recipe, call price_shopping_list once instead.

brands.description: Only these brands, spelt as the brand field of earlier results shows them, e.g. ['Heinz', 'Branston']

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page, to get the next one

limit.description: Products per page, 5 by default, at most 20. Keep it the same when paging.

onOfferOnly.description: Only products on offer, loyalty prices included

ownBrandOnly.description: Only the supermarkets' own brands (Tesco, Sainsbury's, Aldi and so on), limited to the stores given

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'Heinz baked beans 415g' or 'oat milk'. Needed unless brands, category or ownBrandOnly narrow the search.

sort.description: relevance (default); unit_price, cheapest per kg, litre or item first, for comparing pack sizes; price, cheapest pack first; biggest_saving, largest discount first

stores.description: Only products sold at these stores, and only their prices. Leave out for every store.

name: search_grocery_prices

suggestedCategory.description: The aisle most of the query's best matches sit in: pass it as category to drop matches from other aisles

title: Search UK grocery prices
